The '''56th Directors Guild of America Awards''', honoring the outstanding directorial achievements in [[film director|film]]s, [[documentary]] and [[television director|television]] in 2003, were presented on February 7, 2004, at the [[Hyatt Regency Century Plaza]].<ref>{{cite news|last1=King|first1=Susan|title=Jackson takes DGA crown for directing|url=https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-2004-feb-09-et-susan9-story.html|access-date=January 24, 2018|work=Los Angeles Times|date=February 9, 2004}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=DGA Announces Winners of 2003 Outstanding Directorial Achievement Awards and Recipients of DGA 2004 Achievement Awards|url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2004/0208-DGA-Announces-Winners-of-2003-Outstanding-Directorial-Achievement-Awards-and-Recipients-of-DGA.aspx|publisher=Directors Guild of America|access-date=January 24, 2018|date=February 8, 2004}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|last1=Susman|first1=Gary|title=Directors Guild gives "Rings" Peter Jackson top prize|url=https://ew.com/article/2004/02/07/directors-guild-gives-rings-peter-jackson-top-prize/|website=Entertainment Weekly|access-date=January 24, 2018|date=February 7, 2004}}</ref> The ceremony was hosted by [[Carl Reiner]].<ref>{{cite web|title=DGA Sets Host, Presenters for 56th Annual DGA Awards Dinner|url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2004/0130-DGA-Sets-Host-Presenters-for-56th-Annual-DGA-Awards-Dinner.aspx|publisher=Directors Guild of America|access-date=January 24, 2018|date=January 30, 2004}}</ref> The nominees in the feature film category were announced on January 6, 2004<ref>{{cite news|last1=King|first1=Susan|title=DGA nominees include a Coppola -- the next generation|url=https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-2004-jan-07-et-king7-story.html|access-date=January 24, 2018|work=Los Angeles Times|date=January 7, 2004}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last1=King|first1=Susan|title=Directors nominate Coppola / 'Lost' maker is 4th woman to get guild nod|url=http://www.sfgate.com/entertainment/article/Directors-nominate-Coppola-Lost-maker-is-4th-2831860.php|access-date=January 24, 2018|work=San Francisco Chronicle|date=January 8, 2004}}</ref> and the other nominations starting on January 8, 2004.<ref>{{cite web|title=Nominees for Outstanding Directorial Achievement in Movies for Television|url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2004/0108-Nominees-for-Outstanding-Directorial-Achievement-in-Movies-for-Television.aspx|publisher=Directors Guild of America|access-date=January
